specs.title: P19 actual reference shell, three areas, metadata, exact intervals and honest unsupported controls
P19 explicit rich fixture: keyboard crosshair, table selection/paging, zoom and indicator switches
P19 quality is display-only, mismatch hides chart and selected references while metadata keeps actual quality
P19 saved view allowlists display preferences only and safely recovers corrupt local storage
P19 transient same-scope failure retains confirmed chart, switching venue failure clears then explicit recovery reads
P19 custom ISO range rejects invalid pairs without dispatch and preserves a safe canonical URL
P19 viewer has no private mark reads/trade handoff; offline clears selections and shows last confirmation
P19 explicit spot markers remain independent and cross-venue exclusion is preserved
P19 high-fidelity actual-reference dark/light 1672/1024/390 layout and accessibility matrix
